analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진입 이후 3거래일 연속 상승 추세 유지. RSI 47.9→54.5 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착. MACD 히스토그램 0.4986→10.2694로 개선되며 강세 확산. 5일 고가 $978.00, 20일 고가 $1011.77 대비 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 주봉 ADX 46.5로 뚜렷한 추세 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: The uptrend has been sustained for 3 consecutive sessions since the last buy entry. RSI moved from 47.9 to 54.5, exiting oversold territory and settling into neutral. MACD histogram improved from 0.4986 to 10.2694, indicating expanding bullish momentum. A Higher Low pattern is forming relative to the 5-day high of $978.00 and the 20-day high of $1011.77. The weekly ADX at 46.5 confirms a strong trend.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($949.83) vs SMA5/20/50 ($893.64/$883.92/$890.90) — Above short-term and mid-term trends, confirming bullish position.
· Above SMA100/200 ($772.46/$548.68) — Maintaining strong mid-to-long-term uptrend.
· 52-week position (70.0%) + Currently ~24% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.9→54.5) — Exited oversold, entered neutral, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.4986→10.2694) — Continuous improvement, signaling expanding bullishness.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $883.92) — Trading near the middle band, approaching upper band resistance at $998.46.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing Support ($891.66) — Support zone based on SMA20 and Pivot PP ($899.83).
· Swing Resistance ($1011.77) — Key resistance zone aligning with 52-week high and 20-day high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) — Confirmation of recovery signal, uptrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.10x) — Normal volume accompanying upward move, maintaining confidence.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Uptrend) — Holding existing buy position; expecting further rise to $1011.77 if $978.00 (1st resistance) is breached.
